sources.title: How to use Passes on CTA and Pace | Ventra
evidenceExcerpts: SKIP TO MAIN CONTENT SKIP TO MAIN CONTENT Ventra Check Balance | Find a Retailer Account Login Button What's Ventra? Help & How To Transit Benefits Group Sales Ventra App Search About Riding with Transit Passes Passes can be a great way to save money and not worry about loading fare as you go. Pass basics Passes are loaded into the Ventra transit account on your Ventra Card (the very same card you can load with value for individual fares). Passes are good for the precise amount of time the pass is good for. For example, a 1-Day Pass is actually good for exactly 24 hours from the first time it’s used to board a bus or enter a train station. evidenceExcerpts: Skip to Main Content CORPORATE TRANSIT PROGRAM This program lets you encourage employees to use public transportation through nontaxable fare subsidies. HOW THE PROGRAM WORKS Federal law entitles all U.S. employers to a completely tax-deductible business expense of up to $255 per employee per month toward the cost of using public transportation. For most employees this will mean a $95 monthly Express Pass or a $65 monthly Local Pass. Funds can also be allocated to vanpooling. With the help of a HART representative, your Corporate Transit Sponsor Program can be administered by a single employee working just minutes each month. Once your program is set up, bus passes will be mailed or hand-delivered to your company's appointed representative every month, then distributed to eligible employees. Passenger motor carrier service is generally prearranged transportation using vehicles with a seating capacity of between 9 and 28 passengers, not including the driver. Passenger motor carrier vehicles are vans and minibuses. There are four classes of certificates which can be applied for under this type of transportation: Contract carrier Charter service Jitney Special operations The drivers must have a for-hire chauffeur registration, and the vehicles must be inspected. Booting A vehicle is booted when there are three (3) or more outstanding, unpaid parking tickets, the latest of which has been unpaid for a period of at least thirty (30) days. Shared-Ride means that riders will be sharing the vehicle with other passengers and may not be taken directly from their origin to their destination in order to accommodate the needs of all passengers. Shared-ride transportation, sometimes also referred to as paratransit, operates during limited hours and has a set service area where travel is possible. Before using this service, riders must apply in advance for a service program. A reservation is required to take a trip. Shared-ride transportation, sometimes also referred to as paratransit, operates during limited hours and has a set service area where travel is possible. Before using this service, riders must apply in advance for a service program. A reservation is required to take a trip. Programs Some of the available service programs include the following: Senior Shared- Ride Program Medical Assistance Transportation Program (MATP) Americans with Disabilities (ADA) Complimentary Paratransit Program Persons with Disabilities Program (PwD) Application Process The different programs listed above are available depending upon a person’s qualifying background. e. The latest that you can call to arrange a ride for the next day is at least one business day in advance before 12:00 PM. For trips on Saturday or Monday, the latest you can call to arrange a ride is Friday before 12:00 PM. There is a 30-minute pick-up window that begins 15 minutes prior to your scheduled time and ends 15 minutes after your scheduled time. (Example: if your pick-up time is 9:00 AM; your window is 8:45 AM to 9:15 AM) We ask that you please be ready and watch for your vehicle at the agreed pick-up location during this window. To assist all passengers to get to their appointments in a timely fashion, we ask that passengers be ready to board the vehicle when GO Westmoreland arrives. Once the vehicle arrives within the pick-up window at the scheduled location, drivers will only wait 5 minutes until they depart.
